ops.text: DOCUMENTATION RED ON 340cfcab — EXTERNAL REGRESSION, ALREADY FIXED UPSTREAM. The docs-chain re-pin f2211721 (which had NO CI run of its own — pushed and immediately built over) regressed great-docs.yml AND its new source fragment (.claude/fragments/great-docs.yml/great-docs-local.fragment.yml) to a pre-P4 reference list; our P6a landing took the first CI hit: 'Configured reference item(s) not found: ParsedTranscript, TranscriptDiscovery, TranscriptParser, find_transcript, find_transcript_sync, parse_events_async' (all P4-deleted v13 names; d1b8a492 had 0 dead names, f2211721 introduced 6). The owning session self-corrected: 172cf974 (parent = our 340cfcab) restores the v14 surface in BOTH the fragment and the rendered file — landed on main before we authored a duplicate (its first draft 3fa96888 against the pre-P6 base was abandoned when main moved). The 340cfcab main-CI run was auto-cancelled by their follow-up push; the meaningful gate is the current tip cd56687e (= P6a + restore + guides re-render) — watcher armed there. Process notes: (a) great-docs.yml is now fragment-rendered — reference-config edits must go through great-docs-local.fragment.yml or they get clobbered (p6-sweep lane notified; its deletion sweep touches reference config); (b) external landings without their own CI runs shift blame onto the next pusher — check for pre-authored fixes on side refs before authoring one (git log --all --grep found theirs).
